LeoricMasteryConsumeVitalitySkeletalSwin.name: Consume Vitality
LeoricMasteryConsumeVitalitySkeletalSwin.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

LeoricMasteryFealtyUntoDeathUndying.name: Fealty Unto Death
LeoricMasteryFealtyUntoDeathUndying.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 32 Health and 6 Mana.

LeoricMasteryOsseinRenewal.name: Ossein Renewal
LeoricMasteryOsseinRenewal.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

LeoricMasteryGhastlyReachSkeletalSwing.name: Ghastly Reach
LeoricMasteryGhastlyReachSkeletalSwing.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

LeoricMasteryParalyzingRageSkeletalSwing.name: Paralyzing Rage
LeoricMasteryParalyzingRageSkeletalSwing.description: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.

LeoricSkeletalSwingKneelPeasantsTalent.name: Kneel, Peasants!
LeoricSkeletalSwingKneelPeasantsTalent.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

LeoricMasteryWillingVesselDrainHope.name: Willing Vessel
LeoricMasteryWillingVesselDrainHope.description: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.

LeoricMasteryDrainMomentumDrainHope.name: Drain Momentum
LeoricMasteryDrainMomentumDrainHope.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

LeoricMasteryHopelessnessDrainHope.name: Hopelessness
LeoricMasteryHopelessnessDrainHope.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

LeoricHeroicAbilityEntomb.name: Entomb
LeoricHeroicAbilityEntomb.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

LeoricHeroicAbilityMarchoftheBlackKing.name: March of the Black King
LeoricHeroicAbilityMarchoftheBlackKing.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

LeoricMasteryUnyieldingDespairDrainHope.name: Unyielding Despair
LeoricMasteryUnyieldingDespairDrainHope.description: Drain Hope's cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds for every 1 second it is active. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, its cooldown is reduced by an additional 2 seconds.

LeoricWraithWalkOminousWraithTalent.name: Ominous Wraith
LeoricWraithWalkOminousWraithTalent.description: Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

LeoricMasterySpectralLeech.name: Spectral Leech
LeoricMasterySpectralLeech.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.

LeoricDrainHopeCrushingHopeTalent.name: Crushing Hope
LeoricDrainHopeCrushingHopeTalent.description: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.

LeoricMasteryRoyalFocusWraithWalk.name: Royal Focus
LeoricMasteryRoyalFocusWraithWalk.description: Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.

LeoricMithrilMaceTalent.name: Mithril Mace
LeoricMithrilMaceTalent.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%. Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

LeoricMasteryBuriedAliveEntomb.name: Buried Alive
LeoricMasteryBuriedAliveEntomb.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 damage every 1 second.

LeoricMasteryDeathMarchMarchoftheBlackKi.name: Death March
LeoricMasteryDeathMarchMarchoftheBlackKi.description: The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.

LeoricBurningDespairTalent.name: Burning Despair
LeoricBurningDespairTalent.description: Deal 40 damage per second to nearby enemies. While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.

LeoricShroudoftheDeadKingTalent.name: Shroud of the Dead King
LeoricShroudoftheDeadKingTalent.description: Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.
